description: Land  Title Settlement Department - Rajanganaya-yaya 01, Rajanganaya D/S Division,  Anuradhapura District -  Cad. Map No. 11077
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and determinations regarding specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcel numbers, ownership details, extents, and other land-specific information. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes, which cover land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related administrative determinations.
